english.title: Occupier fail to remove waste deposited in contravention of s. 33(1) / regulation 12
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to 59(1) and (5) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
occupier of land in / on which waste had been deposited
in contravention of s.33(1) of the Act / reg 12 of the Environmental Permitting Regulations
served with notice requiring removal of waste
failed to remove the waste within the period specified in the notice

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) "The Environmental Permitting Regulations" presently means the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016.
(ii) Maximum penalty is fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale and a further fine of an amount equal to one-tenth of the greater of £5,000 or level 4 on the standard scale for each day on which the failure continues after conviction of the offence and before the authority has begun to exercise its powers under section 59(6) of the Environmental protection Act 1990

6 months
